CustomField.description: When checked, this action never writes a performance log entry, whatever the thresholds or Log Setting say. Use this for lightweight actions where logging is not needed. Takes precedence over Force Performance Logging if both are checked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check so this action never writes a performance log entry, even when a threshold or Force Performance Logging is set. Use for lightweight actions where logging is not needed.
CustomField.label: Suppress Performance Logging
